description: HUD elements used by both games (godot/scenes/hud.tscn and web/src/hud.ts). Regenerate with: node tools/openrouter/assets.mjs ui-kit
style: Grounded, realistic survival-game UI: dark weathered gunmetal with thin worn brass trim, subtle scratches, soft inner shading. Crisp silhouette readable at small size. No text, letters or numbers.

elements.prompt: Empty horizontal status bar frame for a game HUD: a long, thin rounded-rectangle border with a hollow, dark, semi-transparent interior. Front view, perfectly straight and centred, filling the width.

The fill strip of a horizontal health bar: a long, thin, glossy deep-red energy strip with a soft highlight along its top edge and slightly darker bottom. Flat front view, straight edges, filling the width.
The fill strip of a horizontal stamina bar: a long, thin, glossy warm amber-gold energy strip with a soft highlight along its top edge. Flat front view, straight edges, filling the width.
A single square inventory hotbar slot frame with rounded corners and a dark, semi-transparent empty interior. Front view, centred, filling the canvas.
A single square inventory hotbar slot frame in its selected state: rounded corners, dark semi-transparent interior, and a bright warm glowing gold border. Front view, centred, filling the canvas.
A minimal first-person shooter crosshair reticle: small white centre dot with four short thin white ticks, each with a thin dark outline for contrast. Flat, centred.
Game inventory icon of a steel short sword, diagonal from bottom-left to top-right.
Game inventory icon of an iron pickaxe with a wooden handle, diagonal.
Game inventory icon of a lit wooden torch with a warm flame.
Game inventory icon of a round glass flask filled with glowing red healing potion, cork stopper.
Game inventory icon of a folded parchment map with a red route line.

iconStyle: Painterly realistic game inventory icon, single object centred with a little padding, three-quarter view, soft rim light, no background elements.
